# SPEC 0.1: plain-go version and help stay upstream. The release line keeps
# the upstream text, and no added flag reaches any help text: -O,
# --wasm-loader, and --wasm-features stay out of the command list, every
# help topic, and the generated documentation union.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '

go help
! stdout 'logos'
! stdout 'Logos'

go help documentation
! stdout 'wasm-loader'
! stdout 'wasm-features'
! stdout '\-O'
